# k3d_secret (Data Source)

Reads an existing Secret. Its values are stored in Terraform state, so use an encrypted state backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "k3d_secret" "api" {
  cluster   = "demo"
  namespace = "app"
  name      = "api"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Secret name.

### Optional

- `cluster` (String) Cluster to read from. Exactly one of `cluster` or `kubeconfig` is required.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) Kubeconfig contents, for a cluster reached directly and not through Docker. It is stored in Terraform state.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the object. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) All annotations.
- `data` (Map of String, Sensitive) Keys and decoded values.
- `id` (String) UID of the Secret.
- `labels` (Map of String) All labels.
- `type` (String) Secret type.
